Definition
[Orbifold Euler characteristic] 1. 13.3.3\group surfaces Source: thurston:page-0329

For a cell division subordinate to the isotropy stratification, define $\chi (O)=\sum _C(-1)^{\dim C}/|\Gamma _C|$, where $\Gamma _C$ is the isotropy group on the interior of $C$.
Proof

\sketch Lift the cell division to a manifold covering orbifold. Each lifted cell has $|\Gamma _C|$ translates over $C$, so ordinary Euler characteristic divided by the covering degree gives the displayed weighted sum.

□
